snippet.title: Ninja Cat Remewstered - v1.2mg Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4409630/Ninja_Cat_Remewstered
Or buy on itch.io: https://cubeegames.itch.io/ninja-cat-remewstered (this is currently an older release; it is planned to update at the same time as the Steam launch)

Ninja Cat Remewstered is getting a rather sizeable update with new levels, mechanics, boss fights, custom level support and more!

Additionally, the Steam version will support Steam Achievements and custom levels from Steam Workshop.

I also learnt Kdenlive for this. (Blender wasn't cutting it what with audio sync issues)
I was gonna make a whole mocap 3D model skit for this but I got lazy. Maybe I'll make a "fun" trailer 2 that does more in depth for features.
